skill.footnote: Tiers come from over 3,000 ladder games with known MMR: Beginner under 1,400, Intermediate 1,400 to 1,799, Advanced 1,800 and up, Pro for progamers. Each metric is placed against players of the same race.
skill.caveat.team_game: Tiers are calibrated on 1v1 games; in team games players share the work, so expect some distortion.
skill.caveat.money_map: Tiers are calibrated on regular maps; the extra resources of money maps skew the macro rows.
skill.status.customRules: Custom rules games are not rated.
